observation_summary: The compiler was incorrectly removing unused function arguments during SIMPLE_OPTIMIZATIONS, which broke code relying on the Function.length property.
reasoning_summary: The fix involves adding a conditional guard (`if (!removeGlobals) { return; }`) to prevent the execution of the argument removal logic when global removal is not enabled. This is a classic missing guard/validation check, which falls under the 'Checking' category in ODC.
evidence_used: The fix diff adds a conditional check: if (!removeGlobals) { return; }
The bug report states that SIMPLE_OPTIMIZATIONS should not remove function arguments, implying a missing check for the optimization level or scope context.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the fix changes the execution flow, the root cause is the absence of a guard condition to prevent the algorithm from running in an invalid context.
